reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 7 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Raptors.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Raptors.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 60 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 198 and 247 total points.
